properties.originalText: AIRCRAFT RESCUE AND FIRE FIGHTING (ARFF) OPTIMUM LEVEL OF SERVICE (OLS) IS NOT AVAILABLE FOR ANY AIRCRAFT. REDUCED LEVEL OF SERVICE (RLS) APPLIES TO AIRCRAFT IN CATEGORIES 1-6 (EXCEPT THE A320). DURING RLS, ARFF RESPONSE IS EXPECTED TO CONTROL AND EXTINGUISH POOL FIRES AND PERFORM AIRCREW RESCUE, THOUGH INTERIOR FIREFIGHTING MAY BE LIMITED BY WATER AVAILABILITY. CRITICAL LEVEL OF SERVICE (CLS) APPLIES TO AIRCRAFT IN CATEGORIES 7-10 (INCLUDINGTHE A320). DURING CLS, ARFF RESPONSE FOCUSES ON CONTROLLING POOL FIRES AND PRIORITIZING LIFESAVING ACTIONS, WHILE FULL EXTINGUISHMENT AND INTERIOR FIREFIGHTING ARE RESTRICTED BY WATERSUPPLY AND AIRCRAFT SIZE, AND ASSET LOSS IS ANTICIPATED.
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境
